description: This file defines the InlinePrint class in Twig, representing an internal expression node for inline printing during template compilation. It includes a constructor with deprecation warning and a compile method that outputs code to yield the evaluated node.

classes.name: InlinePrint
classes.description: A final class in Twig representing an internal node for inline print expressions within templates, used during compilation to generate yield statements.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs an InlinePrint node with a given expression node and line number; triggers a deprecation warning.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code to yield the result of the embedded node expression during template compilation.
